question: Can a specified electromagnetic-acoustic-quantum mechanism deliver reproducible net usable energy after all inputs, storage changes and losses are measured?
scope: Three sequential adaptive six-agent panel rounds, selected primary research and official records, simulations and proposed experiments. No physical measurements.
target: Closed-system energy accounting and identifiability; distinguish harvesting, conversion, transfer, storage, free energy in thermodynamics, and an unsupported source-free-power claim.
acceptance: Recorded objection-response-decision for each of exactly three rounds
Every new variable classified and units defined
Typed evidence graph and limitations beside claims
Preserved versions and working multipage interface
Passing tests, published separate branch and live deployment
notClaimed: discovered new law from a fitted residual
